description: A blue panel over a light-grey bed, masked by a centred ellipse half the frame across with `invert: true`: the blue everywhere except a circular hole in the middle through which the grey bed shows. The ellipse matte itself is never drawn. What a wrong render looks like: a blue disc on grey means `invert` was ignored; a white disc means the matte was drawn on its own track; no hole at all means the matte was dropped.
